links.comparator_used: Baseline Gemini 2.5 Flash without fine-tuning (off-the-shelf model); baseline did not receive equivalent safety/deferral instructions
links.effect: baseline 68% vs fine-tuning 92.7% (P<.001, all knowledge-enhanced models vs baseline); fine-tuning+RAG 97.3%
links.tradeoff: Knowledge-enhanced models had lower readability than baseline, partly attributed to standardized safety boilerplate; baseline lacked equivalent safety/deferral instructions, which likely influenced safety findings.
links.quote: All knowledge-enhanced models significantly outperformed baseline in overall accuracy (baseline 68% vs fine-tuning 92.7%, RAG 91.3%, fine-tuning+RAG 97.3%; P<.001).
